en.t: When I came back last night, there was no hot water ready.

units.source_text: 在厨房叽哩哐当地摸了半天，

en.t: I rummaged around noisily in the kitchen for quite a while,

units.source_text: 用早餐剩下的黄酱汤泡了一碗饭，就着咸梅吃。

en.t: I poured the yellow miso soup left from breakfast over a bowl of rice and ate it with a salted plum.

units.source_text: 今早没人来叫我，醒来一看，已是十点半。

en.t: No one came to wake me this morning, and when I opened my eyes, it was already half past ten.

units.source_text: 本来是想七点起来的，却起不来了。”

en.t: I had meant to get up at seven, but I just could not get up."
